definitions.correctness: Source review passed => correct true; failed => false; setup stop/not_reviewable => null.
definitions.source_acceptance: The independent source-review decision; passed maps to accepted, failed maps to rejected, and not_reviewable remains not_reviewable.
definitions.strict_grade: Original frozen grade JSON. behavioral_pass and original_acceptance_status are kept separate; no corrected regrade is substituted.
definitions.index_inclusive_time: Recorded timing.index_inclusive_wall_seconds (or recovered index_inclusive_seconds) and includes code-kb indexing where timed; slot 15 remains null.
definitions.timed_pairs: Include only pairs with both native and code-kb index-inclusive times; exclude undispatched date-fns pairs and slot 15 pair.
definitions.fallback: Code-kb shell actions are item-classified in trace-review/code-kb-shell-actions.json; fallback counts include only related navigation after empty, capped, ambiguous, or error MCP responses.
definitions.repair: Reuse trace-review classifications; slot 23 follows lead adjudication as an observed failure/edit/later-check sequence with causal attribution null.
definitions.attribution: Arm-level differences include full workflow and guidance effects; they do not isolate tool causality. The two native NodaTime source-review failures are not attributed to tool arm.
definitions.corrected_behavior: Eight uniform regrades (four MiniJinja and four NodaTime) remain pending; original grades and source-review decisions are separately retained.
